Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. Putting a short one-pager together (attached) and proposing a 30-min walkthrough Monday to cover: expected token-level cost under three profiles, recommended quantization profile per model type, batching & caching knobs, plus routing policy for burst tolerance.

Quick bullets of what we'll cover:
- Baseline profile: FP16, conservative batching, no KV prefetch (lowest latency)
- Economic profile: 4-bit quantized where E2E output quality tolerates, dynamic batching up to 256, prefix KV caching for repeats (best cost)
- Hybrid profile: mix of the above with regional routing and auto-fallback to standard models during cold starts

Attached is the "onboarding-cost-profile-v1.pdf" with preliminary numbers. Proposed slots: Mon 5/31 09:00 PT or 11:00 PT. Which works?

Thanks — Tessa
